analyst_view.overall: NEC (12th, 7 points) and Rennes (17th, 6 points) are both in the play-off places and a win would push either toward the top eight. NEC lost 4-1 at home to PSV on Saturday and have conceded in 20 straight games; their defence is thin, with Bram Nuytinck, Perr Schuurs, Philippe Sandler and Yassin Moslih out and Emre Mor doubtful, and the numbers count only Schuurs and Mor on the scoring side, none of the defensive gaps. Rennes are four without a win and six away games without a win; Esteban Lepaul is back from an ankle sprain but L'Equipe says not fully fit, Eliezer Mayenda is out with a calf injury, Frankowski is out (counted), and Haise said captain Valentin Rongier could be available. Both sides play again in the league three days later, and Serbian referee Nenad Minakovic (about 3.9 cards a game) is in charge.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals and take about 9% off NEC for Schuurs, but they do not see that NEC's back line is also missing Nuytinck, Sandler and Moslih after shipping four to PSV. Rennes have conceded 16 in their last six away games too, so I lean a little higher, to about 3.6; Lepaul not being fully fit and Mayenda out keep the lean small.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, already adjusted for NEC winning more corners lately (38 in six) and Rennes fewer. The injuries are mostly in NEC's defence and do not change how either side builds attacks, so I stay at 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards, with referee Nenad Minakovic slightly below average (3.9 a game) and Rennes's calm recent card count already in. Both teams need the points but there is no history between them, so I stay at 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.2 shots, already raised for NEC's busy recent shooting (105 in six). A thin NEC defence could let Rennes shoot more, but possible rotation on both sides before the weekend pulls the other way, so I stay at 29.2.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target. With NEC's makeshift back line likely to give Rennes cleaner chances, I lean slightly higher, to about 10.7.
